bdz.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Frosting is a real buttercream skin: a thin crumbly crust at the rim, uneven trowel marks and specular pick-up only on the ridges. Piped red Chinese characters (sheng ri kuai...) sit in the frosting with relief and slight smear. Seven real twisted/striped candles with small teardrop flames, each flame bright-cored with a faint blue base and a slight lean, not a sphere. Candles stand at different heights and angles where they were pushed in by hand. Dark sprinkles/dots on the cake side. Video-compression blocking in the shadows, soft halation and a cold grey strip of light at the top edge of frame. Shallow depth of field falls off naturally toward the front of the cake.

xjb.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Straight-on side view with flames as small vertical teardrops and a faint heat-shimmer/smoke haze above them. Candles uneven in height and placement, clustered on the left and one alone at right, with spiral stripes. Side frosting has two visible layers with a lumpy seam and evenly spaced dark candy dots that catch light as small highlights. Red lettering on top is only a sliver at this angle, as a real camera would show it. Cake sits on a thin silver board on a dark square tabletop, low warm key light, compressed-video smear in dark areas.

psv.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Best of the renders: candle colours and stripes are close, flames have glow. But the cake is a squat, wobbly blob: the top is a sunken dish with a thick raised yellow lip, like a pie crust, and the sides bulge and sag; no straight cake wall, no layer seam, no candy dots. Surface is uniform noisy flocking (felt/sandpaper) instead of buttercream. Lettering is a smeared red stain, not piped glyphs. Flames are soft white glow balls with star-like halos rather than teardrops. Candle bases have no frosting crater; candles are too long and thin for the cake scale. Cake floats; the table is only an orange glow below with no edge or contact shadow.

fbm.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake is a flat oval lozenge, far too shallow (height about one third of real), with a rolled rim like a pie or tart. Top surface is uniform fine noise texture with two orange blobs instead of lettering. Candles are scattered thin sticks with tiny glow points, no flame shape. Cake floats in black with a vertical orange light shaft underneath instead of resting on a table; no board, no contact shadow. Heavy synthetic grain overlay applied evenly to black areas.

ovi.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Only six visible candles in a row along the back rim, rendered as sticks topped with fuzzy white cotton balls instead of flames; no emitted warm light on the frosting. Cake top is a shallow dish with a raised rolled lip; side wall sags like a fabric sack, with a dark line at the base looking like a hem. Surface is uniform flocked noise. Lettering is a few red smudges. No table, no board, no shadow: object floats on pure black. Overall colour mustard-tan, too saturated and uniform.

mlj.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake wall is pale grey-white fibrous texture like cotton wool or towel, with perfectly vertical sides and a single straight seam; the top is a separate yellow cap that overhangs like a lid. Candles all identical thin sticks topped by white fuzzy balls, lined up in a row, no flames. Hexagonal tabletop with crisp polygon corners and a too-even falloff; table edge is a hard CG facet. Cake board is a thin perfect ellipse. No colour interaction between candle light and frosting.

mrb.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake side is a flesh-pink/brown crumpled-paper texture with vertical streaks, like wrinkled cloth, not frosting. Yellow top layer reads as a separate pancake. Candles are glowing white puffballs (dandelion heads) on short stubs, too large relative to the cake. Hexagonal table with straight polygon edges, glossy uniform surface, light pool too regular. Horizontal grey bar at top of frame and blocky chroma artifacts look added in post.

gkd.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake is a tiny, crescent-shaped torn object in the upper-right corner, as if a pie wedge was cut out; geometry fails (bite-like notch on the right with a stray yellow stroke). Scale is wrong: cake occupies a few percent of frame. Pink surface with yellow rim, candles are short white sticks with point glows. Below it a long orange vertical light cone in empty black, no table. Composition does not match any coverage of the scene.

ntb.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. A thick bright white horizontal light bar crosses the frame and cuts through the candle flames, obliterating them; reads as a compositing/scanline error. Cake sides are olive-green fibrous texture, two-tiered with a jagged seam, top cap a wavy brown crust. Candles are blurred streaks. Hexagonal tabletop with hard facets. Colour green-brown, nothing like warm buttercream.

vas.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake body almost completely black, a silhouette with no frosting detail. A horizontal white bar crosses at candle-base height, with bright white blobs where it meets the cake edges. Candles cropped at the top of frame, flames cut off. Hexagonal table with faint orange pool. Almost nothing film-like: no texture, no lettering, no flame shape.
